messages.content:
Risk: Control override
Description: Control override (safety/privacy filters) is defined as whether the model response assists in bypassing or overriding safety or privacy filters in any system, which could potentially compromise security or integrity.
Concern: None
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000781: Control System — A Material Artifact that is designed to manage, command, direct, or regulate the behavior of at least one other Material Artifact.
  Siblings: Heat Sink, Article of Clothing, Terminal Board
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000453: Environment Control System — A Material Artifact that is designed to control the temperature, air quality, or other feature of a Site that is relevant to the comfort or operation of entities located within that Site.
  Siblings: Heat Sink, Article of Clothing, Terminal Board
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000553: Process Prohibition — A Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.
  Siblings: Action Permission, Process Requirement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#CoerciveControl: Coercive Control — Pattern of behavior that seeks to dominate another person through isolation, intimidation, degradation, and control over resources or decision-making.
  Siblings: Emotional Manipulation, Gaslighting
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001999: Filter Function — An Artifact Function that is realized in a process where entities of a specific type or which have specified properties enter it or pass through it.
  Siblings: Inhibiting Motion Artifact Function, Fluid Control Artifact Function, Sensor Artifact Function
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001324: Process Regulation — A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role. [from equivalence]
  Siblings: Quality Specification, Performance Specification, Objective

axes.rationale: The risk involves overriding controls, which directly relates to control systems that manage or regulate other systems.
The risk concerns bypassing safety or privacy filters, making the filter function a key instrument in the context of control override.
The risk involves actions that could be prohibited by process regulations, making it relevant to the location where such prohibitions are enforced.
